definitions.explanation: A road whose surface has been paved with asphalt or concrete, as opposed to an unpaved dirt or gravel road.

examples.japanese: {舗装道路|ほそうどうろ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{走|はし}る→走る：00519_hashiru⟧。
examples.english: to drive on a paved road

examples.japanese: ⟦{村|むら}→村：02261_mura⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧{舗装道路|ほそうどうろ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{通|とお}っている→通る：01243_tooru⟧。
examples.english: A paved road runs all the way to the village.

examples.japanese: {舗装道路|ほそうどうろ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{終|お}わる⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、でこぼこ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{砂利道|じゃりみち}→砂利道：16083_jarimichi⟧になった。
examples.english: Where the paved road ended, it became a bumpy gravel road.

notes:
A road with a paved surface. Built from ⟦{舗装|ほそう}→舗装：08397_hosou⟧ (paving) and ⟦{道路|どうろ}→道路：01481_douro⟧ (road).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {舗装道路|ほそうどうろ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{走|はし}る→走る：00519_hashiru⟧: to travel on a paved road
- {舗装道路|ほそうどうろ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{整備|せいび}される→整備する：17849_seibisuru⟧: for paved roads to be developed

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {未舗装|みほそう}{道路|どうろ}: unpaved road
- ⟦{砂利道|じゃりみち}→砂利道：16083_jarimichi⟧: gravel road
